_how: One entry per release, newest first. scene picks the app window drawn for it (clips, editor, live); tint its backdrop. features (optional) lists everything in that version. Rebuild with python tools/build_site.py.

releases.title: Final release: SocialShot 1.1
notes: Day three, and the version we are standing behind. Every clip from a video now lands in one place, scored, captioned and ready to post, and the website around it loads in a fraction of the time.
changes: The website loads about 60% lighter, built for slow connections
A menu on phones, and a cleaner "Check your inbox" after you sign up
This changelog, with every feature in one place

releases.title: The Windows app, free, by email
notes: Day two. SocialShot for Windows became free for everyone: leave your email and the download arrives with a five-step install guide.
It works with your own AI key from any provider, so you pay that provider only for what you use. The editor got its finishing pass the same day.
changes: Free Windows app, sent by email with an install guide
Your own AI key: OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Grok, Groq, OpenRouter or Ollama
Captions you can fix word by word, and Re-listen for a fresh pass
A cloud version announced for the coming days

releases.title: Launch day
notes: SocialShot went public. Add a creator once and it records whenever they go live, scores every moment from what was said, the voice and the chat, and saves a captioned vertical clip before the stream ends.
changes: Live clipping for Twitch, Kick and YouTube Live
Paste a link or upload a recording
Clips cut to 9:16 with the speaker kept in frame
Hooks, titles and hashtags written for every clip
